rules.message: Leaves from the same plant are subsamples, not replicates. Average within plant (or model plant as random).
Plants sharing a pot share the treatment application; the pot is the experimental unit.
Plants sampled from one field plot are subsamples of that plot. Five plants from one unreplicated plot are NOT five biological replicates of the genotype x environment.
rules.source: Pattern observed in 10.3389/fpls.2021.772177 (unreplicated plots, 5 plants treated as replicates)

rules.message: When irrigation is applied to whole plots, the whole plot is the experimental unit for irrigation; genotype subplots are not replicates of irrigation.

rules.applies_when: treatment delivered to the whole cage (diet, drinking water, enrichment)
rules.message: Treatment delivered via cage diet or drinking water makes the cage the experimental unit; n = number of cages per group.
rules.source: ARRIVE 2.0 item 1b (Percie du Sert et al. 2020, PLoS Biol 18:e3000410)

rules.applies_when: treatment given to the dam or whole litter
rules.message: For prenatal or maternal treatments the litter is the experimental unit. Add litters, not pups; use a mixed model with (1 | litter).
Cells from one animal or donor are not biological replicates. Aggregate to pseudobulk per donor before differential expression.
Wells from one culture/passage are technical replicates. Independent experiments (different days/passages) are the replicates.
rules.source: Vaux, Fidler & Cumming 2012, EMBO Rep 13:291-296, doi:10.1038/embor.2012.36

rules.message: Re-sequencing the same library is a technical replicate; biological replicates are independent samples.
Repeated MS injections of one extract are technical replicates; pooled QCs measure precision, not biological variance.
Destructive sampling means different plants at each time point; this is not a repeated-measures design.
rules.source: Design logic; see 10.1073/pnas.1907500116 (weekly destructive sampling, 3 reps x 10 pooled plants)

rules.message: Flies in one vial share food and microenvironment; replicate vials and model (1 | vial).
rules.source: Piper & Partridge 2016, doi:10.1007/978-1-4939-6371-3_18; Lazic et al. 2018, doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.2005282

rules.message: Bottom-watered or flooded trays make the tray the unit for that treatment.
Plants in one chamber are subsamples for chamber-level treatments; replicate chambers or runs.
